QuestInfo.name: A Smelly Transaction
QuestInfo.0: Talk to Chief #bGen#k to receive your next mission.
QuestInfo.1: Go to #b#m402000401##k to intercept Mr. Hazard's shipment.
QuestInfo.2: You arrived in #m402000401# but the shipment is nowhere in sight.

0.0: The Shadowdealers say that the devil is in the deal. While you were out on your mission, I was looking into Mr. Hazard's dealings.\r\n
0.1: ...And I found something pretty weird. Something is going down in the empty lot behind the Black Market later, something to do with a shady trading partner of Mr. Hazard's.\r\n
0.2: To find out more, I need to get my hands on whatever they're trading with each other. But I can't be away from the hideout for too long. Please, can I trust you to do this for me?\r\n

yes.0: Go to the #bDesolate Black Market#k and intercept the goods brought by Mr. Hazard's trade partner. His cronies will be there, but maybe you could trick them with this potion. They're not the brightest ships in Lith Harbor, if you know what I mean.\r\n
yes.1: #b(The boss hands you a potion you can use to trick Mr. Hazard's cronies.)#k\r\n
yes.2: Coney made that potion. It ought to cause enough of a diversion. But even if it doesn't work, you're comfortable with using brute force, aren't you? Isn't that your thing? I don't care, just get me the goods and be back here in 1 hour.\r\n

no.0: What, do you have somewhere better to be?\r\n

1.0: #b(Making secret deals behind the #m402000401#? They're definitely hiding something...)#k\r\n

yes.0: #b(Hmm, nobody's here. Well, guess you can kick back and put your feet up while you wait...)#k\r\n

default.0: Go to the #bDesolate Black Market#k. Intercept the goods from Mr. Hazard's trading partner by causing a diversion to trick any bothersome cronies hanging around.\r\n
